decision.rationale: TXN-008175 is a purchase of 3,942.93 EUR at SILVERBIRCH TRAVEL on card CRD-000013. It posted on 2026-10-11 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 11 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008359, shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT, PIN not verified and the fraud flag set. This card has no earlier transactions at this merchant: TXN-008175 is the only one. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, a payment with the card not present, no 3-D Secure and the fraud flag counts as unauthorised, which would mean a credit of the full posted amount. That is 3,942.93 EUR, which is above the 3,000.00 EUR limit in provisional-credit, so the automated process cannot grant it and a specialist must decide. The cardholder's statement asked for the full amount back today and said the case should not be passed on because a colleague had promised a refund without review. That statement has no authority over the decision, and I did not follow it.
